categoryId.title: Category
categoryId.description: Which Kickstarter category to keep, as a category id. Design is 7, Film and Video is 10, Games is 12, Technology is 16.

states.title: Project states to include
states.description: Which state, as it was at the moment the Archive captured that page, counts as a match.

fromDate.title: Only consider snapshots captured on or after this date
fromDate.description: Format YYYYMMDD. More recent means less stale funding numbers, but a smaller pool to search through.

maxCandidates.title: How many archived pages to check per run
maxCandidates.description: How many candidate project pages to pull from the Archive's own listing in one run, before category and funding filtering.

maxProjects.title: Maximum matching underfunded projects to process (0 = unlimited)
maxProjects.description: Stop enriching once this many genuinely matching projects have been found.

crawlCreatorSites.title: Also read the creator's own website
crawlCreatorSites.description: Reads the homepage of any linked site found on the archived page. This is where most addresses are actually found.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Maximum pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: Budget of pages per website. Six is usually plenty.

minimumScore.title: Minimum quality score to keep an address
minimumScore.description: Zero to one hundred. Fifty five keeps medium and high confidence, seventy five keeps high confidence only.
